mapper.insert:
insert into cr_task_log (resource_id, room_id, mission_id, action_code, user_id, task_id, create_time, update_time) values
(#{taskLost.resourceId}, #{taskLost.roomId}, #{taskLost.missionId}, #{taskLost.actionCode}, #{taskLost.userId}, #{taskLost.taskId}, now(),now())
mapper.select: select m.event_type as type,count(t.resource_id) as count from cr_task_log t LEFT JOIN cr_mission m on t.resource_id = m.resource_id where t.room_id = #{roomId} and (t.action_code =${RELEASED} or t.action_code =${CLOSE}) and m.event_type is not null group by m.event_type
